name: publishes the parts of one call a macrotask apart: what one resolves runs before the next is published

note: Internal writer fixture asserts final call sizes [1,2], not public Session admissions with a continuation.
Internal writer fixture checks four publications (including a held part), not the exact source total of three after all three caller resolutions.

name: publishes no part of a call after a failure that a continuation of an earlier part caused

note: Storage scope failure suppresses a later publication after lead. It does not preserve the exact [lead,one] prefix or trigger failure from the resolved one continuation.
Exact SessionFailed is checked at a deferred storage-scope boundary rather than after the previous part’s continuation performs a failing task read.
Existing exact cause check is for an explicit failure injected by the deferred storage scope, not the injected task-read error.

name: publishes no part of a call after the Session fails in a continuation of an earlier part

note: Storage scope failure suppresses a later publication after lead, but it is not called by one’s continuation and does not assert the [lead,one] prefix.
Existing check uses a storage-triggered failure with separate storage calls, not explicit failure after a resolved part in the held group.

A public Session test must establish exactly two later parts in one Storage call; the second caller sees two publications before the third can publish. The two failure cases require the exact [lead,one] prefix and later SessionFailed; the backend task read case must retain the identical read error. Do not substitute the storage-scope entry failure or pre-settlement refusal.
